    Finiteness of bricks and stable bricks at a fixed dimension vector #

    Corollary 3.3 and Corollary 5.4 (Theorem A(II)) of the manuscript:

    • exists_projective_weight_stable_of_isEFinite (Corollary 3.3): over an E-finite algebra, every finite-dimensional brick is stable at some integral weight.
    • finite_brickClassesOfClass_of_isEFinite: over any field, E-finiteness implies finiteness of bricks in every fixed Grothendieck class, since two bricks with the same class and the same set of proper subobject classes share a stabilizing weight and are therefore isomorphic.
    • isEFinite_iff_dim_brick and isEFinite_iff_dim_stab (Corollary 5.4 / Theorem A(II)): over an infinite field, E-finiteness is equivalent to (dim-brick) (Schur-representation-finiteness) and to (dim-stab).
